Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Associate position at the Global Strategic Communications Council (GSCC) / Meliore Foundation. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to shifting narratives around building decarbonization in the EU.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills in crafting clear, compelling content and managing cross-functional projects. I have experience with WordPress, Google Analytics, and SEO tools, and I am comfortable working with remote teams across time zones. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to translate technical topics into accessible narratives, a skill I am eager to apply to EU building policies like the EPBD and ETS2.

I am based in Belgium and have the right to work in the EU. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am enthusiastic about learning complex topics and collaborating with diverse partners to drive campaign impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Associate position at the Global Strategic Communications Council (GSCC) / Meliore Foundation. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am drawn to the opportunity to apply my skills to the urgent challenge of decarbonizing the built environment in the EU.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed expertise in crafting clear, engaging content that translates complex topics into accessible narratives. I have managed on-page SEO, written keyword-targeted blog posts, and built and maintained WordPress sites, all while collaborating with remote teams and meeting tight deadlines. My project mirook.com, a website for a Belgian youth chess champion, showcases my ability to implement structured data and optimize for both traditional and AI-powered search engines—a skill that aligns with the need to shift public and political narratives.

I am particularly excited about the operational coordination aspect of this role. My experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously and my familiarity with tools like Slack and Google Workspace make me well-suited to support cross-border campaigns and partner ecosystems. I am eager to learn about EU policy files such as the EPBD and ETS2 and to help craft narratives that resonate with everyday concerns like energy bills and comfort.

Based in Belgium, I have the right to work in the EU and am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am committed to an inclusive approach to climate communication and am excited to contribute to a remote-first, international team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can support the GSCC's mission.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score
